transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We've got the resupply aircraft departing at 0900 tomorrow with four cargo positions to fill — P1 forward-left, P2 forward-right, P3 aft-left, and P4 aft-right. We need to place the battery pallet, refrigerated clinic shipment, generator-filter crate, and communications-cable pallet, one per position. Let's hear from each of you on your specific constraints so we can get this load plan sorted and I can sign off on it.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical constraint on the battery pallet. I confirmed this morning that the battery pallet's certified tie-down points are compatible only with the rated fittings at P2 — forward-right. The updated cargo-certification sheet hasn't been attached to the load-plan packet yet, but the battery pallet must go in P2.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical constraint on the refrigerated clinic shipment. I confirmed that it must be placed at P1 — the position nearest the aircraft power outlet — and its cooler must be connected to aircraft power by 0830. The medical shipping instruction was received after yesterday's planning meeting and hasn't been entered on the manifest yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical constraint on the generator-filter crate. I measured it this morning at 1.9 meters high, and only P4 — aft-right — has the required overhead clearance for it. The measurement is documented in my maintenance shop worksheet but hasn't been sent to the air-movement desk yet. The generator-filter crate must go in P4.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical constraint on the communications-cable pallet. I confirmed that it must occupy P3 — aft-left — so its reels remain within the aircraft's approved center-of-gravity loading band. It also requires a separate-load segregation label. The air-load diagram has not yet been updated with the signal section's certification, so we need to get that documented before the crew accepts the cargo.
transcript.speaker: A5

Send generator-filter crate height measurement worksheet to the air-movement desk documenting P4 clearance requirement before crew accepts cargo.
